name: 11-tunnel-and-relay
teaches: The rendezvous relay and drt tunnel: a machine with no inbound address parks an outbound WSS leg by label, a caller opens a second one, and the relay splices them so ssh rides over the top. The two lines that run without a second machine are refusals — tunnel naming its three shapes, and a relay refusing a blank key at load, before anything listens.
cmd: echo '$ drt tunnel'; drt tunnel; echo "exit $?"; echo; echo '$ drt relay --config rendezvous.host.lua'; drt relay --config rendezvous.host.lua; echo "exit $?"
